Check-In Instructions

Select your route below

Step 1
Head to the Letterbox Area
Pull up as close as you can to 1 Watkin Street Bruce and walk along the front path toward the letterbox bank.
Step 2
Find Letterbox 305 & Enter Your Code
Turn right at the letterboxes and look for letterbox 305 on the right hand side. Enter the code provided in your check-in message and press OK.
Step 3
Retrieve Your Keys
Retrieve your keys from the letterbox. The remote is used to activate building doors and the lift.
Step 4
Enter Through the Foyer
Once you have your keys, proceed straight ahead through the foyer entry doors.
Step 5
Take the Lift to Level 3
Inside the building, take the lift. Hold your remote to the reader inside the lift and press Level 3.
Step 6
Find Apartment 305
Once you exit the lift on Level 3, look for door number 305. The number is clearly marked on the door. Use your key to enter — enjoy your stay!
Step 1
Head to the Letterbox Area
Pull up as close as you can to 1 Watkin Street Bruce and walk along the front path toward the letterbox bank.
Step 2
Find Letterbox 305 & Enter Your Code
Turn right at the letterboxes and look for letterbox 305 on the right hand side. Enter the code provided in your check-in message and press OK.
Step 3
Retrieve Your Keys
Retrieve your keys from the letterbox. The remote is used to activate building doors, the carpark, and the lift.
Step 4
Drive to the Carpark
Return to your vehicle. Proceed down Watkin Street and turn left into the 2nd driveway on the left.
Step 5
Proceed Down the Driveway
The driveway looks like this. Proceed all the way down to the black garage door.
Step 6
Open the Garage Door
Once close to the door, use the buttons on the remote to open the garage door.
Step 7
Take an Immediate Left
Once through the door, take an immediate left.
Step 8
Drive to the End and Turn Right
Drive to the end of the aisle and turn right.
Step 9
Your Carpark Is on the Right
The carpark is located on the right hand side.
Step 10
Find Space 305-1
You are looking for space 305-1 marked on the floor.
Step 11
Find the Building Elevator
Once parked, the building elevator is located to the left of your car space. You are on Level B.
Step 12
Take the Lift to Level 3
Inside the lift, hold your remote to the reader to unlock the floors, then press Level 3.
Step 13
Find Apartment 305
Once you exit the lift on Level 3, look for door number 305. The number is clearly marked on the door. Use your key to enter — enjoy your stay!
